concerns.text: The plan assumes a ‘Reddit Loneliness Longitudinal Dataset’ is available via a Zenodo DOI (e.g., “Success depends on the Zenodo DOI delivering required columns”). However, the research.md notes that no verified public source exists for this dataset. Without a reachable, open dataset containing the required variables, the study cannot be executed as described.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 1 – Data Ingestion & Matching section (lines describing abort criteria)
concerns.text: The abort condition is set to halt if matched users < 500, yet the Success Criteria (SC‑006) require ≥ 600 participants with ≥ 6 months of data. This mismatch means the pipeline could proceed while still failing the study’s own power requirement, making the dataset size handling inappropriate.
